00062     inline vFloat VEC_MUL_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00063     {
00064         vFloat returnVec;
00065         float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00066         float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00067         float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00068         
00069         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ * *rightFloat++;
00070         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ * *rightFloat++;
00071         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ * *rightFloat++;
00072         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ * *rightFloat++;
00073         
00074         return returnVec;
00075     }
00076 
00077     inline vFloat VEC_ADD_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00078     {
00079         vFloat returnVec;
00080         float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00081         float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00082         float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00083         
00084         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ + *rightFloat++;
00085         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ + *rightFloat++;
00086         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ + *rightFloat++;
00087         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ + *rightFloat++;
00088         
00089         return returnVec;
00090     }
00091 
00092     inline vFloat VEC_SUB_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00093     {
00094         vFloat returnVec;
00095         float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00096         float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00097         float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00098         
00099         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ - *rightFloat++;
00100         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ - *rightFloat++;
00101         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ - *rightFloat++;
00102         *returnFloat++ = *leftFloat++ - *rightFloat++;
00103         
00104         return returnVec;
00105     }

00136     // e.g. fftsize=8
00137     //            | Positive FFT   | Negative FFT
00138     //Bin         | Real part      | imaginary part  | imaginary part
00139     //------------+----------------+-----------------+----------------0 
00140     //0  dc       | f [0]          | 0               | 0
00141     //1           | f [1]          | f [5]           | -f [5]
00142     //2           | f [2],         | f [6]           | -f [6]
00143     //3           | f [3]          | f [7]           | -f [7]
00144     //4  nyquist  | f [4]          | 0               | 0
00145     //
00146     //... mirror:
00147     //
00148     //5           | f [3]          | -f [7]          | f [7]
00149     //6           | f [2]          | -f [6]          | f [6]
00150     //7           | f [1]          | -f [5]          | f [5]
00151 #endif

00166     ~FFTEngineInternal();

00173     inline void setFFTWindow(Buffer const& window) throw() 
00174     { 
00175         fftWindow = window.resample(fftSize); 
00176         fftWindowSamples = fftWindow.getData();
00177         fftWindowFactor = fftWindow.sum(0) / fftSize;

00187              Buffer const& inputBuffer,

00189              const int outputChannel = 0,
00190              const int inputChannel = 0) throw();
00191     
00192     inline void fft(DSPSplitComplex& outputBuffer, const float* const inputBuffer) throw()
00193     {
00194 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00195         memcpy(transformBufferSamples, inputBuffer, fftSizeBytes);
00196         fftwf_execute(fftwPlan);
00197 
00198         float nyquist = transformBufferSamples[fftSize]; // remember nyquist val
00199         float *interleavedSamples = transformBufferSamples;
00200         // deinteleave
00201         for(int j = 0; j < fftSizeHalved; j++)
00202         {
00203             outputBuffer.realp[j] = *interleavedSamples++;
00204             outputBuffer.imagp[j] = *interleavedSamples++;
00205         }
00206         outputBuffer.imagp[0] = nyquist; // pack nyquist in
00207         
00208 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00209         fftReal->do_fft(transformBufferSamples, inputBuffer);
00210         memcpy(outputBuffer.realp, transformBufferSplit.realp, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00211         memcpy(outputBuffer.imagp, transformBufferSplit.imagp, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00212         
00213 #else
00214         static float scale = 0.5f;
00215         vDSP_vsmul(inputBuffer, 1, &scale, transformBufferSamples, 1, fftSize);
00216         ctoz ((COMPLEX *) transformBufferSamples, 2, &outputBuffer, 1, fftSizeHalved);
00217         fft_zrip (fftvDSP, &outputBuffer, 1, fftSizeLog2, FFT_FORWARD);
00218         
00219 #endif
00220     }
00221     
00222     void fft(DSPSplitComplex& outputBuffer, const float* const inputBuffer, const bool applyWindow) throw();
00223     
00224     void ifft(Buffer const& outputBuffer, 
00225               Buffer const& inputBuffer, 
00226               const bool applyWindow = false, 
00227               const bool applyScaling = false,
00228               const int outputChannel = 0,
00229               const int inputChannel = 0) throw();
00230     
00231     inline void ifft(float* const outputBuffer, DSPSplitComplex const& inputBuffer) throw()
00232     {
00233 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW    
00234         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSize);
00235         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeHalved);
00236         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeBytes);
00237         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00238         
00239         LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, transformBufferSamples);
00240         LOCAL_DECLARE(DSPSplitComplex&, transformBufferSplit);
00241 
00242         float *interleavedSamples = transformBufferSamples;
00243         for(int j = 0; j < fftSizeHalved; j++)
00244         {
00245             *interleavedSamples++ = inputBuffer.realp[j];
00246             *interleavedSamples++ = inputBuffer.imagp[j];
00247         }
00248         transformBufferSamples[fftSize  ] = transformBufferSamples[1]; // nyquist
00249         transformBufferSamples[fftSize+1] = 0.f; // nyquist imag always zero
00250         transformBufferSamples[1        ] = 0.f; // DC imag always zero
00251         
00252         fftwf_execute(ifftwPlan);
00253         memcpy(outputBuffer, transformBufferSamples, fftSizeBytes);
00254 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00255         memcpy(transformBufferSplit.realp, inputBuffer.realp, fftSizeBytes);
00256         fftReal->do_ifft(transformBufferSamples, outputBuffer);
00257 #else
00258         memcpy(transformBufferSplit.realp, inputBuffer.realp, fftSizeBytes);
00259         fft_zrip (fftvDSP, &transformBufferSplit, 1, fftSizeLog2, FFT_INVERSE);
00260         ztoc (&transformBufferSplit, 1, (COMPLEX *) outputBuffer, 2, fftSizeHalved);
00261 #endif      
00262     }
00263     
00264     void ifft(float* const outputBuffer, DSPSplitComplex const& inputBuffer, const bool applyWindow, const bool applyScaling) throw();
